courses.overview: 以下是有共同物理與介面的延伸課程；每項都指出不可直接照搬的邊界。
courses.overviewEn: These extensions share physics/interfaces; each identifies a boundary that prevents direct copying.

related.title: 電池儲能電站整合
related.difference: 整站需再計入 PCS、輔機與多串不平衡
related.differenceEn: Plants also include PCS, auxiliaries and string imbalance
practice: 以「可用電量與功率限制」建立兩課的共同介面圖，標示訊號、能量與單位。
用本課教學算例改變一個輸入，列出轉移到「電池儲能電站整合」時需補充的資料。
針對「整站需再計入 PCS、輔機與多串不平衡」設計一個反例；先預測，再以合成資料或公開量測驗證。
practiceEn: Draw the shared interface for available charge and power limits, labeling signals, energy and units.
Change one input in this course’s worked example and list additional data needed for Battery energy-storage system integration.
Design a counterexample to the transfer boundary: Plants also include PCS, auxiliaries and string imbalance. Predict first, then check using synthetic data or public measurements.

courses.summary: 本課聚焦單體量測、SOC 估測、均衡與分層保護。地圖提供公開研究或產業交流的背景；本課的模型和假設不宣稱在該處實測、發明或量產。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on cell measurements, SOC estimation, balancing and layered protection. The map provides public research/industry context; course models and assumptions are not claimed to have been measured, invented or manufactured there.

history.title: 跨領域研究機構成立
history.text: PNNL 官方沿革記載其成立於 1965 年。化學、材料和系統工程研究在此相連；這是儲能技術研究的代表脈絡，並非每項課程的發明地。
history.textEn: PNNL records its founding in 1965. Chemistry, materials and system engineering connect here; this is representative storage-research context, not the birthplace of every course topic.

history.title: Grid Storage Launchpad 啟用
history.text: PNNL 於 2024 年公布 Grid Storage Launchpad 啟用，連結材料研究與儲能系統驗證。課程因而把元件指標與可交付系統性能分開檢查。
history.textEn: PNNL announced the Grid Storage Launchpad opening in 2024, connecting materials research and storage-system validation. The curriculum likewise checks component metrics separately from deliverable system performance.

courses.connection: 從標記單體與電池組的課程問題出發，依來源追溯研究、元件供應與系統驗證的分工；代表地點不等於完整供應鏈。
courses.connectionEn: Start with label cells and packs and trace roles in research, components and system validation; the reference location does not represent the entire supply chain.
